thread.title: Apple iPhone XS Max sales looked strong over the first weekend, says Rosenblatt

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple iPhone XS Max sales looked strong over the first weekend, says Rosenblatt
text: Rosenblatt Securities analyst Jun Zhang wrote Monday that early sales trends for the iPhone XS Max looked strong following the first official weekend that consumers could buy the new Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.44% device. He said that sales trends looked weak, however for the smaller, cheaper iPhone XS, and that the company has leftover inventory of the device. While he estimates that combined sales of the two phones were higher than sales of the iPhone X in its first weekend a year ago, he attributes that mainly to "a better production ramp" this time around and expects that iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max together won't sell as well as the iPhone X over a two-month period. He rates Apple's stock a buy with a $200 price target. The stock is up 0.5% in Monday morning trading and up 44% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.68% of which Apple is a component, has gained 19% in that time.
